name: PrivCo
description: PrivCo is the leading provider of financial data on U.S. private companies — the bootstrapped, family-owned, VC- and PE-backed businesses that never file public financials. This connector gives Claude direct access to PrivCo's database of 2M+ private companies, so you can research, screen, and analyze the private market in plain conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PrivCo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PrivCo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.privco.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PrivCo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PrivCo lists 17 MCP tools, including company_contact, company_search, deal_search, financials, funding_search, general_profile, identification, industry_keyword, industry_pics, investor_contact, ma_deals, and match.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PrivCo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PrivCo in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
PrivCo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PrivCo is developed by PrivCo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
